弗洛拉FLORA：一种从异构激光雷达数据预测森林属性的深度学习方法: A deep learning approach to predict forest attributes from heterogeneous LiDAR data

Emilie Vautier Clément Mallet Cédric Vega
摘要Abstract

森林属性对于国家规模的资源监测至关重要。在支持国家森林清查 (NFI) 估算的辅助数据中，机载 LiDAR 指标与森林属性的相关性最强。然而，当在异构条件下获取 LiDAR 数据时，生成可操作的全面预测仍然具有挑战性。随着国家激光雷达项目在欧洲范围内扩展，飞行限制、传感器、季节和扫描角度的变化成为一致森林属性测绘的主要障碍。现有模型通常是局部的，很难推广到其校准范围之外，特别是在全国范围内结构多样的森林中。Forest attributes are essential for national-scale resource monitoring. Among auxiliary data supporting National Forest Inventory (NFI) estimates, airborne LiDAR metrics are among the most strongly correlated with forest attributes. However, producing operational wall-to-wall predictions remains challenging when LiDAR data are acquired under heterogeneous conditions. As national LiDAR programs expand across Europe, variability in flight constraints, sensors, seasons, and scan angles becomes a major obstacle to consistent forest attribute mapping. Existing models are often local and struggle to generalize beyond their calibration domain, especially at national scale over structurally diverse forests.

我们呈现We present弗洛拉FLORA（带有辅助数据的森林 LiDAR 八叉树回归），一种深度学习框架，可根据异构 LiDAR 点云预测六种森林属性：主导高度、总体积、落叶和针叶体积、断面积和茎密度。(Forest LiDAR Octree Regression with Auxiliary Data), a deep learning framework predicting six forest attributes: dominant height, total volume, deciduous and coniferous volumes, basal area, and stem density, from heterogeneous LiDAR point clouds.弗洛拉FLORA通过后期融合门控机制将基于八叉树的高分辨率主干与生态和时空辅助变量相结合，从而实现每个森林属性预测的上下文数据贡献的部分可解释性。使用法国大陆 32,052 个国家森林清查地块以及来自法国 LiDAR HD 项目的数据（涵盖不同的森林类型和采集条件）对模型进行训练和评估。combines an octree-based high-resolution backbone with ecological and spatiotemporal auxiliary variables through a late-fusion gating mechanism, enabling partial interpretability of contextual data contributions for each forest attribute prediction. Models are trained and evaluated using 32,052 National Forest Inventory plots across mainland France, using data from the French LiDAR HD program covering diverse forest types and acquisition conditions.

实验表明，针对叶上和叶下采集联合训练的单一模型优于特定季节模型，并提高了跨季节鲁棒性。辅助变量提供了适度的总体收益，但揭示了属性相关的贡献，特别是对于特定物种的体积预测。该模型在主导高度 (rRMSEExperiments show that a single model trained jointly on leaf-on and leaf-off acquisitions outperforms season-specific models and improves cross-season robustness. Auxiliary variables provide modest overall gains but reveal attribute-dependent contributions, particularly for species-specific volume prediction. The model achieves strong performance for dominant height (rRMSE≈12.3%\approx 12.3\%,R², R²≈0.88\approx 0.88）和总体积的竞争结果（rRMSE) and competitive results for total volume (rRMSE≈39%\approx 39\%,R², R²≈0.74\approx 0.74）。这些结果确立了). These results establish弗洛拉FLORA作为国家激光雷达项目大规模森林属性估计的可靠基线。as a robust baseline for large-scale forest attribute estimation from national LiDAR programs.

{亮点}{highlights}

LiDAR 采集的可变性会影响森林属性预测。LiDAR acquisition variability affects forest attributes predictions.

法国全国 LiDAR 数据集可实现大规模异构分析。Nationwide French LiDAR dataset enable large-scale heterogeneous analysis.

深度学习利用激光雷达点云，同时保留森林结构以进行森林属性估计。Deep learning exploits LiDAR point clouds while preserving forest structure for forest attributes estimation.

针对特定季节的训练模型在不同的物候中会失败。Season-specific trained models fail across different phenology.

多赛季训练提高了稳健性和全国范围的可转移性。Multi-season training improves robustness and national-scale transferability.

1 简介Introduction

国家森林清查（NFI）旨在估计并有时监测国家范围内给定可靠性水平的森林特征变化。为了在不增加实地调查成本的情况下缩小 NFI 估计规模，同时保持估计的可靠性，已经开发了将 NFI 数据与辅助数据相结合的方法。这些所谓的多源森林清单（MSNFI）通常依赖于根据其与感兴趣的森林属性的相关性、低成本、在国家范围内的可用性以及定期的长期更新而选择的遥感数据National Forest Inventories (NFIs) are designed to estimate and sometimes to monitor the change in forests characteristics at National scale with a given level of reliability. In order to downscale NFI estimates without increasing the cost of field surveys while preserving the reliability of the estimates, methods have been developed to combine NFI data with auxiliary data. Those so-called Multisource Forest Inventories (MSNFIs) usually rely on remote sensing data selected for their correlation with the forest attributes of interest, their low cost, and their availability at the national scale, together with their regular long-term renewal(Tomppo et al., 2008)。就相关性而言，来自机载激光扫描、立体摄影测量以及较小程度的雷达干涉测量的 3D 数据是森林结构属性（例如体积和生物量）的最合适的辅助信息来源. In terms of correlation, 3D data derived from airborne laser scanning, stereophotogrammetry, and, to a lesser extent, radar interferometry are the most suitable sources of auxiliary information for structural forest attributes such as volume and biomass(Borsah et al., 2023)。随着国家级 LiDAR 数据库的发展，人们重新燃起了对其在 MSNFI 中使用的兴趣。也就是说，数据采集和处理尚未标准化，这使得将其集成到 MSNFI 中成为一项挑战。. With the development of national-scale LiDAR databases, interest in their use within MSNFIs has been renewed. That said, data acquisition and processing are not standardized, making their integration into MSNFIs a challenge.

LiDAR数据处理方法是针对本地获取的点云建立的，并且通常具有相似的获取条件。然而，国家采购面临着重大挑战，国家采购通常依赖于在不同采购条件下获得的点云LiDAR data processing methods are established for point clouds acquired locally, and often with similar acquisition conditions. Nevertheless, a significant challenge arises with national acquisitions, which often rely on point clouds acquired under varying acquisition conditions(Petras et al., 2023)。 早期研究指出，LiDAR采集参数如飞行高度、扫描角度、脉冲密度和传感器特性影响森林结构属性的估计。. Early studies have pointed out that LiDAR acquisition parameters such as flying altitude, scan angle, pulse density, and sensor characteristics influence the estimation of forest structural attributes.Næsset (2009)结果表明，从成熟针叶林 40 多个田间地块的四次机载激光扫描 (ALS) 采集中，仪器类型、飞行高度和脉冲重复频率都会影响 ALS 导出的高度和密度指标，尽管整体模型精度仅存在微小差异，但平均树高和木材体积采集之间的系统差异高达 2.5% 和 10.7%。showed, from four Airborne Laser Scanning (ALS) acquisitions over 40 field plots in mature conifer forest, that instrument type, flying altitude, and pulse repetition frequency all affect ALS-derived height and density metrics, with systematic differences between acquisitions of up to 2.5% for mean tree height and 10.7% for timber volume, despite only minor differences in overall model precision.Gopalakrishnan et al. (2015)进一步证明，使用线性回归further demonstrated, using linear regression on∼\sim美国东南部 76 个异构 ALS 项目的 1,800 个田野图，结合了大面积的异构 LiDAR 数据集，引入了额外的可变性，点密度、扫描角度和植被异质性等因素影响模型精度，尽管冠层高度仍然可以用 3.0 m (R) 的均方根误差 (RMSE) 进行预测。1,800 field plots across 76 heterogeneous ALS projects in the Southeastern US, that combining heterogeneous LiDAR datasets over large areas introduces additional variability, with factors such as point density, scan angle, and vegetation heterogeneity influencing model accuracy, though canopy height could still be predicted with a root mean squared error (RMSE) of 3.0 m (R2= 0.74)，在结构均质的林分中减少至 2.4 m。= 0.74), reduced to 2.4 m in structurally homogeneous stands.Qin et al. (2017)特别强调扫描角度作为树叶轮廓检索的关键参数，确定最佳角度为 20specifically highlighted the scan angle as a critical parameter for foliage profile retrieval, identifying an optimal angle of 20∘无论飞行高度或脉冲密度如何，同时表明组合多个扫描角度可以进一步提高估计精度。regardless of flying altitude or pulse density, while showing that combining multiple scan angles can further improve estimation accuracy.

叶上和叶下采集条件之间的差异已被证明会极大地影响冠层结构的表示和森林属性的估计。在Differences between leaf-on and leaf-off acquisition conditions have been shown to substantially affect canopy structure representation and the estimation of forest attributes. In落叶的deciduous特别是，没有树叶会导致信号通过冠层的穿透力更强，从而导致来自地面的单次和最后回波数量增多，并且在落叶条件下回波分布向较低高度移动stands in particular, the absence of foliage leads to a greater penetration of the signal through the canopy, resulting in a higher number of single and last returns originating from the ground and a shift of the return distribution toward lower heights under leaf-off conditions(Ørka et al., 2010)。这些结构差异对模型可迁移性有直接影响：应用 k 最近邻 (kNN) 算法（一种基于最相似观测值预测值的非参数方法），通过分析最相似数据点的体积来预测与体积相关的值，在叶开条件下训练到叶离数据（反之亦然）会引入很大的偏差，因此应避免. These structural differences have direct consequences for model transferability: applying a k-nearest neighbors (kNN) algorithm, a non-parametric method that predicts values based on the most similar observations, to predict volume-related values by analyzing the volumes of the most similar data points, trained under leaf-on conditions to leaf-off data (and vice versa) introduces substantial bias and should therefore be avoided(Villikka et al., 2012)。 这种性能下降已在芬兰两个清查区域的北方森林环境中使用随机森林模型进行了量化，其中交叉使用叶上和叶下模型增加了相对均方根误差（rRMSE）并导致高估和低估，特别是在. This degradation in performance has been quantified in boreal forest contexts using Random Forest models across two inventory areas in Finland, where cross-using leaf-on and leaf-off models increased relative Root Mean Square Error (rRMSE) and led to both over and underestimation, particularly in落叶的deciduous- 主导地块。在这些情况下，错误几乎增加了一倍（从-dominated plots. In these cases, error nearly doubled (from∼\sim33% 至33% to∼\sim56%），偏差高达 29%，尽管通过经验比率估计器进行校准已证明可以部分减轻这些误差56%) and bias reached up to 29%, although calibration via an empirical ratio estimator was shown to partially mitigate these errors(Maltamo et al., 2025)。与这些发现一致的是，进一步的证据表明，随机森林模型和采集条件的交叉应用会导致两种森林类型的误差大幅增加，针叶林的 rRMSE 平均绝对增量高达 16.8%，落叶林的 rRMSE 平均绝对增量高达 25.8%，这表明应避免这种不匹配. Consistent with these findings, further evidence shows that cross-application of random forest models and acquisition conditions results in large increases in error for both forest types, with average absolute increases of rRMSE up to 16.8% for coniferous stands and 25.8% for deciduous stands, reinforcing that such mismatches should be avoided(White et al., 2015)。这些结果凸显了在开发和应用基于激光雷达的森林属性模型时考虑物候条件的至关重要性。. These results highlight the critical importance of accounting for phenological conditions when developing and applying LiDAR-based forest attribute models.

估计的可靠性也随森林类型的不同而变化（即使是粗略的水平，例如The reliability of estimates also vary with the forest type (even at a coarse level such as针叶树的coniferous, 落叶的deciduous, 和, and混交林mixed forests）。对于). For落叶的deciduous对于树木，叶子条件影响点的分布，在有叶条件下，点分布向上冠倾斜，对地面的渗透有限，在叶子脱落条件下，随着地面采样的增加，点分布会向较低的树冠水平移动trees, leaf conditions influence the distribution of points, with skewed distributions toward the upper crown in leaf-on conditions with limited penetration to the ground, to shifted point distribution toward lower canopy levels with increased ground sampling in leaf-off conditions(Davison et al., 2020)。纯净. Pure针叶树的coniferous展位受收购条件的影响往往最小stands tend to be minimally impacted by acquisition conditions(Wasser et al., 2013)，尽管仍然存在阔叶树、较低的植被和部分冬季针叶稀疏, albeit the residual presence of broadleaf trees, lower vegetation and partial winter needle thinning(Davison et al., 2020)仍然引入了可变性。人们可以得出这样的结论：最近的发现和模型在很大程度上依赖于区域和收购still introduces variability. One can conclude that most recent findings and models are heavily area- and acquisition-dependent(Fareed et al., 2026).

总而言之，这些与采集相关和物候变化的来源使得开发森林变量估计模型变得特别具有挑战性，该模型能够推广到超出其当地或区域规模以及训练条件的范围。这激励了更强大、更大规模的方法的开发。Taken together, these acquisition-related and phenological sources of variability make it particularly challenging to develop forest variable estimation models that generalize beyond their local or regional scales, and the conditions under which they were trained. This motivates the development of more robust, large-scale approaches.

据我们所知，迄今为止，使用能够处理多种森林类型和激光雷达采集设置的单一通用模型来估计国家范围内的森林属性仍然是一个悬而未决的问题，作者并不知道此类调查。在本文中，我们利用法国国家 LiDAR HD 计划来应对这一挑战。这种采集程序提供了独特的大型异构 3D 点云数据集，最小密度为 10 pts/mEstimating forest attributes at national scale with a single, generic model capable of handling a large diversity of forest types and LiDAR acquisition settings remains, to the best of our knowledge, an open problem as to date, the authors are not aware of such investigations. In this paper, we address this challenge by leveraging the French national LiDAR HD program. Such acquisition program provides a uniquely large and heterogeneous dataset of 3D point clouds, with minimum density of 10 pts/m2收购分布在落叶和落叶条件下。法国森林占 68%and acquisitions distributed across both leaf-off and leaf-on conditions. French forests are dominated at 68% by落叶的deciduous林分，一种结构信号受到物候强烈调节的森林类型：此类数据集捕获了以前研究中很少遇到的变异性。五年的采集窗口进一步加剧了这种异质性，该窗口跨越了在不同季节和仪器条件下进行的多个活动，使得数据集不仅很大，而且本质上是可变的。stands, a forest type whose structural signal is strongly modulated by phenology: such dataset captures a variability rarely encountered in previous studies. This heterogeneity is further compounded by the five-year acquisition window, which spans multiple campaigns conducted under different seasonal and instrumental conditions, making the dataset not only large but intrinsically variable.

据我们所知，尽管文献中提出了几种解决采集异质性的策略，但在这种情况下，协调在很大程度上仍未得到探索。 一种方法是为每个收购活动或季节开发单独的估计模型，如Harmonization remains, to our knowledge, largely unexplored in this context, although several strategies have been proposed in the literature to address acquisition heterogeneity. One approach consists in developing separate estimation models for each acquisition campaign or season, as implemented byNilsson et al. (2017)在瑞典 NFI 框架内：使用最近的 NFI 图拟合特定区块（通常为 25 公里 x 50 公里）线性回归模型，以解释全国不同 ALS 传感器和采集设置引入的变异性。或者，已提出线性混合效应模型来解释森林类型和采集变异性，如within the Swedish NFI framework: block-specific (usually 25 km by 50 km in size) linear regression models were fitted using the nearest NFI plots to account for the variability introduced by different ALS sensors and acquisition settings across the country. Alternatively, linear mixed-effects models have been proposed to account for both forest type and acquisition variability, as demonstrated byHauglin et al. (2021)在挪威森林资源地图的背景下，十年来获得的 367 个 ALS 项目的数据通过按物种和成熟度等级分层与 NFI 图相结合。物种特异性模型的体积、地上生物量、断面积和 Lorey 高度的 rRMSE 分别为 35%、34%、31% 和 12%，比一般非分层模型高 2-7 个百分点。in the context of the Norwegian forest resource map, where data from 367 ALS projects acquired over ten years were combined with NFI plots through stratification by species and maturity class. Species-specific models yielded rRMSE of 35%, 34%, 31% and 12% for volume, aboveground biomass, basal area and Lorey’s height, respectively, outperforming general unstratified models by 2–7 percentage points.

然而，在全国范围内，根据采集条件和森林类型对模型进行明确分层仍然具有挑战性，其中森林组成、气候和地形的复合多样性，加上由于误差传播而难以聚合小区域However, explicitly stratifying models by acquisition condition and forest type remains challenging at national scale, where the compounding diversity of forest composition, climate, and topography, combined with the difficulty of aggregating small areas due to error propagation(Walshe et al., 2021; Saarela et al., 2016; Breidenbach et al., 2014)限制了此类方法的实际适用性。空间可转移性问题进一步说明了这些局限性：limits the practical applicability of such approaches. The question of spatial transferability further illustrates these limitations:Soininen et al. (2025)提出了一种结合芬兰各地 ALS 和 NFI 数据的随机森林方法，但报告称 RMSE 随着与训练集的地理距离的增加而系统性增加，凸显了此类模型在空间异质性下的泛化能力有限。此外，物候学仅代表问题的一个维度：飞行高度、传感器类型和点密度均以与森林类型和结构相互作用的方式影响点云特性。这使得详尽的分层既不切实际，又可能不充分。更稳健的解决方案需要一种形式proposed a Random Forest approach combining ALS and NFI data across Finland, yet reported a systematic increase in RMSE with geographic distance from the training set, highlighting the limited generalization capacity of such models under spatial heterogeneity. Moreover, phenology represents only one dimension of the problem: flight altitude, sensor type, and point density each influence point cloud properties in ways that interact with forest type and structure. This renders exhaustive stratification both impractical and potentially inadequate. A more robust solution requires a form of协调harmonization，无论是应用于输入数据级别（使 3D 点云在几何形状方面相似）还是应用于预测级别（无论上述波动如何，都估计一致的森林变量）。, whether applied at the input data level (making 3D point clouds similar in terms of geometry) or at the prediction level (estimating consistent forest variable whatever the above-mentioned fluctuations).

一种简单的方法包括通过将所有 3D 点云转换为特定的目标条件来均质化数据集（One straightforward approach would consist in homogenizing datasets by converting all 3D point clouds into a specific targeted condition (例如，e.g.,叶上）。然而，除了物候学之外，许多其他采集特征（例如飞行高度、传感器类型、密度及其与每种森林类型和结构的相互作用）已被证明会影响点云属性leaf-on). However, beyond phenology, many other acquisition characteristics like flight altitude, sensor type, density as well as their interaction with each forest type and structure have been shown to affect point cloud properties(Jakubowski et al., 2013; LaRue et al., 2022)。对每个已知效应进行显式标准化是一项复杂的重建任务，并且对于异构数据集上的大规模操作使用可能不切实际. Explicitly normalizing for every known effect is a complex reconstruction task, and likely impractical for large-scale operational use on heterogeneous datasets(Rüetschi et al., 2021)。它还基于这样的假设：可以检索森林的正确几何形状。然而，文献主要关注点云补全，并且仅在单个树级别或不透明表面上得到解决. It is also based on the assumption that it is possible to retrieve the correct geometry of forests. However, the literature mainly focuses on point cloud completion and has only been addressed at the individual tree level or for opaque surfaces(Bornand et al., 2024; Luo et al., 2026).

相反，另一种方法可以专注于预测类似的输出。它假设统计模型可以捕获这种异质性，并且可以自动学习根据采集和季节背景调整其预测。这一假设得到了支持Instead, another approach could focus on predicting similar outputs. It assumes a statistical model can capture such heterogeneity and can automatically learn to adjust its prediction to the acquisition and seasonal context. This hypothesis is supported byWhite et al. (2015)。他们表明，使用在加拿大艾伯塔省黑松为主的森林中的 787 个地块上训练的随机森林模型，将叶上和叶下数据汇集到单个模型中只会导致边际性能损失（针叶林的 rRMSE 为 ¡2%，落叶林的 rRMSE 接近于零）。这表明单个模型可以隐式适应两种采集条件，而无需显式分层。 在更大的尺度上，. They showed, using Random Forest models trained on 787 ground plots in a lodgepole pine-dominated forest in Alberta, Canada, that pooling leaf-on and leaf-off data into a single model results in only marginal performance loss (¡2% rRMSE for coniferous, near-zero for deciduous stands). This suggests that a single model can implicitly accommodate both acquisition conditions without explicit stratification. At larger scales,Hauglin et al. (2021)进一步证明，即使在采集异质性很强的情况下，这种方法仍然可行，成功地将十多年来在挪威 17 Mha 森林中采集的 367 个 ALS 项目的数据组合到一个建模框架内。further demonstrated that such an approach remains feasible even under strong acquisition heterogeneity, successfully combining data from 367 ALS projects acquired over a decade across 17 Mha of Norwegian forest within a single modeling framework.

传统的机器学习方法依赖于将精心设计的源自点云的统计特征与森林清查图的地面实况测量值配对来执行预测。森林属性（体积、生物量、断面积等）的回归模型通常基于随机森林和 kNN 算法，当应用于异构条件时，通常难以泛化。即使像 kNN 这样的方法具有使用邻居的经验分位数或自举法提供置信区间的优点Traditional machine learning approaches rely on pairing carefully designed statistical features derived from point clouds with ground-truth measurements from forest inventory plots to perform predictions. Regression models for forest attributes (volume, biomass, basal area, etc.), typically based on Random forest and kNN algorithms, often struggle to generalize when applied over heterogeneous conditions. Even if methods like kNN have the advantage of providing confidence intervals using empirical quantiles of the neighbors or bootstrapping(Sagar et al., 2025)，他们仍然受到学习鲁棒可转移表示的能力的限制, they are still limited by their ability to learn robust transferable representation(Villikka et al., 2012; Parra et al., 2025)。深度学习 (DL) 的最新进展为克服这些限制提供了新的视角。. Recent advances in deep learning (DL) offer new perspectives to overcome these limitations.Oehmcke et al. (2023)强调与最先进的机器学习方法相比，森林属性的深度学习回归可以产生更准确的结果。 通过直接在原始点云上操作，深度学习模型保留了数据的完整三维结构，并自动学习相关的空间特征，绕过了手动特征选择的需要以及点云局部几何形状的波动。highlight that DL regression of forest attributes can produce more accurate results compared to state-of the art machine learning methods. By operating directly on raw point clouds, DL models preserve the full three-dimensional structure of the data and automatically learn relevant spatial features, bypassing the need for manual feature selection, and fluctuation in the local geometry of point clouds.

已经提出了几种 DL 架构来处理 3D 点云，大致分为两类：基于点的方法和基于体素的方法。基于点的方法依靠采样或分组策略来捕获本地上下文Several DL architectures have been proposed to process 3D point clouds, broadly falling into two categories: point-based and voxel-based approaches. Point-based approaches rely on sampling or grouping strategies to capture local context(Wu et al., 2024; Geist et al., 2025)，这种策略不太适合森林冠层的结构不规则性，其中植被密度不断变化并且不存在明确的物体边界。相比之下，基于体素的离散化可以保留结构信息，同时 保持计算效率，并且更好地适应森林点云的稀疏和异构性质。, a strategy that is not well suited to the structural irregularity of forest canopies, where vegetation density varies continuously and no clear object boundaries exist. Voxel-based discretizations, in contrast, preserve structural information while maintaining computational efficiency, and are better adapted to the sparse and heterogeneous nature of forest point clouds.
Seely et al. (2023)评估了温带混合森林中用于森林属性回归的两种深度学习架构：基于点的动态图卷积神经网络（DGCNN）和基于体素的八叉树卷积神经网络（OCNN）。他们的结果表明，虽然两种深度学习方法都优于随机森林，但基于体素的 OCNN 实现了最低的预测误差并降低了平均绝对百分比误差。evaluated two DL architectures for forest attribute regression in a temperate mixed forest: the point-based Dynamic Graph Convolutional Neural Network (DGCNN) and the voxel-based Octree Convolutional Neural Network (OCNN). Their results show that while both DL methods outperformed Random Forests, the voxel-based OCNN achieved the lowest prediction errors and reduced mean absolute percentage error.Oehmcke et al. (2024)在他们对丹麦国家森林机载 LiDAR 生物量估计的研究中，采用并比较了三种不同的深度学习架构进行回归：基于点的 PointNet、基于点的核点卷积 (KPConv) 和基于体素的 Minkowski 卷积神经网络。其中，基于体素的 Minkowski CNN 在所有森林属性和评估指标上始终优于基于点的替代方案。 两项研究都强调，(i) 基于体素的架构对森林类型的变化表现出更大的鲁棒性，(ii) 通过使用可能不完全时间对齐的多年 NFI 和 LiDAR 数据训练 DL 模型，可以实现可靠的预测。, in their study on airborne LiDAR biomass estimation over Danish national forests, adapted and compared three distinct DL architectures for regression: the point-based PointNet, the point-based Kernel Point Convolution (KPConv), and the voxel-based Minkowski convolutional neural network. Among these, the voxel-based Minkowski CNN consistently outperformed both point-based alternatives across all forest attributes and evaluation metrics. Both studies highlight that (i) voxel-based architectures exhibit greater robustness to variations in forest type, (ii) reliable predictions are conceivable by training a DL model with multi-annual NFI and LiDAR data that may not be fully temporally aligned.

在本文中，我们提出了一种通用的深度学习解决方案，称为In this paper, we propose a generic deep-learning solution, dubbed弗洛拉FLORA（带有辅助数据的森林 LiDAR 八叉树回归），用于估计国家级别的森林属性，可以处理国家范围内通常遇到的各种森林和 LiDAR 数据条件。(Forest LiDAR Octree Regression with Auxiliary data), for estimating forest attributes at a national-level, that can handle a large diversity of both forest and LiDAR data conditions usually encountered at national scales.弗洛拉FLORA是一种基于体素的方法，旨在根据异构 LiDAR 数据估计森林结构属性，该方法在法国进行了验证，因为法国可以联合使用大规模 NFI 和 LiDAR 数据。到目前为止，提议的数据还没有这种规模的对应数据is a voxel-based approach designed to estimate forest structural attributes from heterogeneous LiDAR data, validated over France where large-scale NFI and LiDAR data are jointly available. The proposed data does not have counterpart of this size so far(Wegen et al., 2025)。我们的模型预测通常从 LiDAR 数据得出的六个属性. Our model predicts six attributes commonly derived from LiDAR data(Coops et al., 2021)。我们在这里重点关注以下六个：主导高度、总体积、. We focused here on the following six : dominant height, total volume,落叶的deciduous站立体积，stand volume,针叶树的coniferous林分体积、茎密度和断面积。 使用 rRMSE (%) 和决定系数 (stand volume, stem density, and basal area. Model performance was evaluated using the rRMSE (%) and the coefficient of determination (R2R^{2}），分别测量预测误差和解释方差。 这项工作解决了三个主要目标。我们首先研究与使用特定季节数据训练的模型相比，在对比物候条件（叶生和叶落）下获取的数据训练的单个深度学习模型是否可以跨季节泛化，以及这种鲁棒性是否适用于整个森林类型。然后，我们检查在叶上和叶下条件下调查的重叠图的具体贡献，作为一种训练策略，将模型锚定到不同采集环境下对同一森林的配对观测。最后，我们评估辅助上下文变量在提高异构采集条件下的预测准确性方面的附加值。), which measure prediction error and explained variance, respectively. This work addresses three main objectives. We first investigate whether a single DL model trained on data acquired under contrasting phenological conditions (leaf-on and leaf-off) can generalize across seasons as compared to models trained with season-specific data , and whether this robustness holds across forest types. We then examine the specific contribution of overlapping plots, surveyed under both leaf-on and leaf-off conditions, as a training strategy that anchors the model to paired observations of the same forest under varying acquisition contexts. Finally, we assess the added value of auxiliary contextual variables in improving prediction accuracy across heterogeneous acquisition conditions.

2 材料和方法Materials and methods

2.1 数据Data

我们的方法在情节层面上执行，并且旨在处理在法国大陆领土上发现的各种背景。优点有两个：这确保了（i）大量数据和（ii）显着的多样性，因此捕获我们的泛化任务所需的非常异构的行为。Our approach perform at plot-level and is framed to handle a large diversity of context, has found in the French mainland territory. The advantages are two-fold: this ensures (i) a large amount of data and (ii) significant diversity, therefore capturing very heterogeneous behaviors necessary for our generalization task.

2.1.1 研究区Study area

法国森林面积约1750万公顷，约占法国大陆陆地面积的32%French forests cover approximately 17.5 million hectares, representing about 32% of the land area of mainland France(Vidal et al., 2016)。它们主要由阔叶树种组成，约 68% 的森林面积由落叶林组成。森林所有权主要为私人所有，近四分之三的林地为私人所有。从林分结构来看，法国一半以上的森林由混合林组成，由不同的阔叶树种或阔叶树与针叶树的混合林组成，而纯针叶林则较少。在法国本土，森林中有近 190 种不同的树种，分布在七种主要树种中：橡树、山毛榉、板栗、海松、欧洲赤松、云杉和冷杉. They are predominantly composed of broadleaved species, with around 68% of the forest areas consisting of deciduous stands. Forest ownership is largely private, as nearly three quarters of forest land is privately owned. In terms of stand structure, more than half of French forests consist of mixed stands, combining either different broadleaved species or mixtures of broadleaved trees and conifers, while pure coniferous stands are less frequent. In metropolitan France, forests contain nearly 190 different tree species, distributed among seven main species: oak, beech, chestnut, maritime pine, Scots pine, spruce, and fir(IGN, 2025).

这种结构和成分的多样性与法国气候和地形的高度异质性密切相关，其中包括海洋性、大陆性、地中海和山地气候。因此，法国森林呈现出多种多样的森林类型和结构This structural and compositional diversity is closely linked to the high climatic and topographic heterogeneity of France, which includes oceanic, continental, Mediterranean and mountainous climates. As a result, French forests display a wide range of forest types and structures(Bontemps et al., 2019; Kalinicheva et al., 2025).

2.1.2 激光雷达数据LiDAR data

我们受益于在法国国家 LiDAR HD 计划框架内获取的大规模 3D 机载 LiDAR 数据，该计划于 2021 年启动，为期 5 年。该计划的目标是在大都市区和群青地区（法属圭亚那除外）以开放获取的方式获取和发布 LiDAR 数据，点密度至少为 10 脉冲/米We benefit from the large scale 3D airborne LiDAR data acquired in the framework of the French National LiDAR HD program, started in 2021 for a 5 years duration. The objective of the program is to acquire and release in open access LiDAR data over the metropolitan area and ultramarine territories, with the exception of French Guyana, with a point density of at least 10 pulses/m2。选择这样的脉冲密度是为了满足数字地形模型 (DTM) 生成、土地覆盖测绘和统计任务的空间采样要求. Such a pulse density was selected to fulfill spatial sampling requirements for both Digital Terrain Model (DTM) generation, land-cover mapping and statistical tasks(Gaydon and Roche, 2025)，有时达到 40 pts/m, reaching sometimes 40 pts/m2。 为了实现如此大规模的多年活动，领土被划分为50公里. To achieve such a large multi-year campaign, the territory was divided into 50 km×\times50 公里的补丁，每个补丁都归属于六家选定的私营公司之一或 IGN。全年进行了采集，并根据地形和激光雷达设备调整了测量参数。采用了多种激光雷达系统，具有不同的发射能量、脉冲率，并在多种飞行高度、平面速度和扫描角度范围下运行（图 1）。50 km patches, which were each attributed to one of the six selected private companies or to IGN. Acquisitions were conducted throughout the year, with survey parameters adapted to the relief and the LiDAR device. Several LiDAR systems were employed, with varying emitted energy, pulse rate and operated under multiple flight heights, plane speed and scan angle ranges (Fig.1）。此外，在调查期间没有进行年际和年内规划（). In addition, without inter- and intra-annual planning in the survey periods (例如，e.g.,基于森林管理或景观一致性），相邻的斑块可能在不同的季节和不同的年份被不同的公司收购。通过整合至少进行了两次调查的 2-5 公里重叠区域，可以减少斑块之间的边缘效应。based on forest management or landscape consistency), adjacent patches may have been acquired by different companies, under different seasons, and distinct years. Edge effects between patches are reduced by integrating an overlap region of 2-5 km in which at least two surveys were performed.

原始数据处理主要使用TerraScan软件的自动例程进行，并使用Myria3D DL工具进行分类Raw data processing was mainly performed using automatic routines involving TerraScan software, and classified with Myria3D DL tool(Gaydon, 2022)。我们使用分类点云作为我们方法的输入数据，因为它允许我们直接保留地面和植被类并丢弃其他点，从而简化了预处理步骤。. We used the classified point cloud as the input data for our approach, as it allowed us to directly retain only the ground and vegetation classes and discard the other points, thereby simplifying the preprocessing steps.

2.1.3 法国国家森林清查数据French national forest inventory data

法国 NFI 是基于对分布在全境 1 公里网格上的半永久性地块进行系统抽样。每年，都会对 1/10 的网格进行勘察，并对大约 14,000 个地块进行实地调查，其中一半是首次勘察，另一半是相隔 5 年重新勘察的。使用半径为 6、9、15 和 25 米的同心圆形子图在现场收集有关现有森林和植被的定量和定性数据。展位描述是在最大的地块上进行的。根据树木直径，在其他三个半径上收集树木测量数据：胸高直径 (DBH) 在 [7.5 cm – 22.5 cm] 范围内的树木在 6 m 半径图上进行测量，在 [22.5 cm] 范围内的树木进行测量The French NFI is based on a systematic sampling of semi-permanent plots distributed across the territory on a 1 km grid. Each year, 1/10 of the grid is explored and around 14,000 plots are surveyed on the field, half of them been visited for the first time, and the other half have been revisited 5 years apart. Quantitative and qualitative data on standing forests and vegetation are collected in the field using concentric circular subplots of 6, 9, 15, and 25 m radius. Stand description is done on the largest plots. Dendrometric data are collected on the three other radius, according to tree diameter: trees with a Diameter at Breast Height (DBH) in the range [7.5 cm – 22.5 cm] are measured on the 6 m radius plot, those in the range [22.5 cm−-47.5厘米]是在9米半径的地块上测量的，较大的树木是在15米半径的地块上测量的。情节47.5 cm] are measured on the 9 m radius plot, and larger trees on the 15 m radius plot. Plot−-森林属性的水平估计是在每公顷的基础上使用树木包含概率、实地测量以及某些变量（如体积）的异速生长模型得出的。在本研究的框架中，我们仅依赖首次访问图并考虑茎密度（茎 halevel estimates of forest attributes are derived on a per  ha basis using the probability of inclusion of trees, field measurements as well as allometric models for some variables like volume. In the framework of this research, we relied only on first visit plots and considered the stem density (stems ha-1）、断面积（m), the basal area (m2 ha-1)、茎体积(m), the stem volume (m3 ha-1) 及其在硬木和针叶树之间的分布，以及主导高度 (m)。) and its distribution between hardwoods and conifer, as well as dominant height (m).

The distribution of residualsH95−HdH_{95}-H_{d}是正偏斜的：我们应用了不对称拒绝标准：如果满足以下条件，则排除图：is positively skewed: we applied an asymmetric rejection criterion: plots were excluded ifH95−Hd<−2​σH_{95}-H_{d}<-2\sigma or H95−Hd>+3​σH_{95}-H_{d}>+3\sigma, 其中, whereσ\sigma表示残差分布的标准差 (denotes the standard deviation of the residual distribution (σ=3.89\sigma=3.89\>米）。更严格的下限反映了一个事实，即严重低估了m). Conversely, moderate overestimation ofH95H_{95}相对于relative toHdH_{d}可能来自合法的物理来源：众所周知，陡峭的地形斜坡会在 CHM 归一化中引入高度误差can arise from legitimate physical sources: steep terrain slopes are known to introduce height errors in CHM normalization(Vega et al., 2014)，并且 DTM 插值期间稀疏的地面点密度可能会导致残留归一化偏差，两者都会导致冠层高度估计值夸大。这些伪影不一定反映现场调查和激光雷达采集之间的不匹配，我们希望尽可能忠实于现场测量，而不是积极丢弃潜在的有效图。因此，高估是可以容忍的, and a sparse ground point density during DTM interpolation may lead to residual normalization biases, both resulting in inflated canopy height estimates. These artifacts do not necessarily reflect a mismatch between the field survey and the LiDAR acquisition, and we wish to remain as faithful as possible to the field measurements rather than aggressively discarding potentially valid plots. 2.2 方法Methods

弗洛拉FLORA旨在使用足够多样性的 LiDAR 点云来估计地块级别的各种森林属性，并且应该与森林类型无关。这是一项回归任务，可通过机器学习解决方案有效处理，并且不需要任何初步的单个树冠检测步骤is designed to estimate various forest attributes at the plot level using a sufficient diversity of LiDAR point clouds and that should be agnostic to the forest type. This is a regression task that is efficiently handled with machine learning solutions and that does not require any preliminary individual tree crown detection step(Fan et al., 2026).

2.2.1 模型架构Model architecture

计算策略Computational strategy

我们的问题可以转化为Our problem can be cast as an协调harmonization因此，它应该在空间、时间和情节构成上表现出很强的泛化能力。我们选择了基于八叉树的卷积神经网络与高分辨率网络（OCNN-HRNet）架构相结合challenge, it should therefore exhibit a strong generalization ability over space, time, and plot composition. We selected an Octree-based Convolutional Neural Network combined with a High-Resolution Net (OCNN-HRNet) architecture developed byWang et al. (2017)，并且已经证明对于森林属性回归是有效的, and already proved effective for forest attribute regression bySeely et al. (2023)，同时保持简单。 所提出的框架旨在直接对原始点云数据进行操作，因为八叉树结构的转换是作为模型训练之前的预处理步骤自动执行的（图 1）。, while remaining simple. The proposed framework is designed to operate directly on raw point cloud data, as the conversion into octree structures is automatically performed as a preprocessing step prior to model training (Fig.3）。 为了提高训练稳定性并加速收敛，在使用 z 分数变换进行训练之前，将每个目标变量归一化为零均值和单位方差). To improve training stability and accelerate convergence, each target variable is normalized to zero mean and unit variance prior to training using a z-score transformation(Ayrey et al., 2021)。这是由于六个森林属性的大小和方差存在巨大差异（. This is motivated by the large differences in magnitude and variance across the six forest attributes (例如，e.g.,体积以米表示volumes are expressed in m3 ha-1而断面积的单位是 mwhile basal area is in m2 ha-1），否则会导致损失函数由最高方差属性主导。具体来说，对于每个目标), which would otherwise cause the loss function to be dominated by the highest-variance attributes. Concretely, for each targetkk，归一化值计算为, the normalized value is computed asy~k=(yk−μk)/σk\tilde{y}_{k}=(y_{k}-\mu_{k})/\sigma_{k}, 其中, whereμk\mu_{k}和andσk\sigma_{k}是训练集上估计的平均值和标准差。这确保了所有属性在训练期间对损失的贡献相同，无论其物理规模或绝对大小如何。在评估之前，预测会被反向转换为原始尺度。are the mean and standard deviation estimated over the training set. This ensures that all attributes contribute equally to the loss during training, regardless of their physical scale or absolute magnitude. 详细设计Detailed design

模型架构首先从基于八叉树的输入中提取特征，将原始三维点云数据转换为每个节点的特征表示（图 1）。The model architecture begins with feature extraction from octree-based inputs, transforming raw three-dimensional point cloud data into per-node feature representations (Fig.3A 部分）。八叉树卷积和最大池层的初始堆栈降低了空间分辨率，同时增加了特征维度，以较粗糙的八叉树深度生成第一组特征图（图 1）。part A). An initial stack of octree convolution and max-pooling layers reduces the spatial resolution while increasing feature dimensionality, producing the first set of feature maps at a coarser octree depth (Fig.3B 部分）。part B).

网络的核心遵循适合八叉树结构数据的 HRNet 架构（图 1）。The core of the network follows a HRNet architecture adapted to octree-structured data (Fig.3C 部分）。在每个阶段，并行分支使用具有瓶颈卷积的残差块处理不同八叉树深度的特征图，对应于不同的空间分辨率。第一级在单个高分辨率分支（128 个通道）上运行。在第二级中，以一半的分辨率（256 个通道）引入第二个分支，在第三级中以更粗的分辨率（512 个通道）添加第三个分支。在阶段之间，转换模块同时在所有分支对之间交换信息：每个分支并行接收来自所有其他分支的贡献，这些贡献是根据相同的输入状态计算的。这些贡献通过连续最大池化（对于高分辨率源）或最近邻上采样（对于较低分辨率源）重新采样到目标八叉树深度，其中part C). At each stage, parallel branches process feature maps at different octree depths, corresponding to different spatial resolutions, using residual blocks with bottleneck convolutions. The first stage operates on a single high-resolution branch (128 channels). In the second stage, a second branch is introduced at half the resolution (256 channels), and in the third stage a third branch is added at an even coarser resolution (512 channels). Between stages, a transition module simultaneously exchanges information across all branch pairs: each branch receives contributions from all other branches in parallel, computed from the same input state. These contributions are resampled to the target octree depth via successive max-pooling (for higher-resolution sources) or nearest-neighbour upsampling (for lower-resolution sources), with a1×11{\times}1当通道维度不同时应用卷积，并按元素求和以形成更新的分支输入。convolution applied when channel dimensions differ, and summed element-wise to form the updated branch input.

在 HRNet 阶段之后，多分辨率特征图被连接起来（图 2）。After the HRNet stages, the multi-resolution feature maps are concatenated (Fig.3D 部分），产生 896 个通道的组合表示（128 + 256 + 512）。甲 1part D), resulting in a combined representation of 896 channels (128 + 256 + 512). A 1×\times然后，1 个卷积层和全局池化层将空间信息聚合到单个 1024 维特征向量中，并应用 dropout 进行正则化。最后，在原始模型中1 convolution and global pooling layers then aggregate spatial information into a single 1024-dimensional feature vector, with dropout applied for regularization. Finally, in the original model fromSeely et al. (2023)，由两个具有 ReLU 激活的线性层组成的多层感知器回归器处理该向量并输出最终的回归估计。, a multilayer perceptron regressor composed of two linear layers with ReLU activations processes this vector and outputs the final regression estimates.

我们对森林属性深度回归的现有工作提出了几项改进：网络优化、增强的多功能性和上下文感知估计。首先，我们执行系统的超参数搜索，以使原始架构适应我们的预测任务。我们的六个目标是异质规模和生态意义的连续森林结构属性：最佳学习率、权重衰减和批量大小可能与We propose several improvements with respect to existing works on deep-based regression of forest attributes : network optimization, increased versatility and context-aware estimation. First, we perform a systematic hyperparameter search to adapt the original architecture to our prediction task. Our six targets are continuous forest structural attributes of heterogeneous scale and ecological meaning: the optimal learning rate, weight decay and batch size may differ substantially from those reported in(Seely et al., 2023)重点关注地上生物量估算。其次，我们将模型设计为仅依赖于每个点的 3D 空间坐标 (XYZ)，故意排除强度和回波相关属性，例如回波数、回波数和扫描角度。尽管最初考虑了这些功能，但超参数优化显示，包含这些功能并没有带来一致的性能增益，而由于缺乏辐射传感器校准，强度测量被丢弃。将输入限制为 XYZ 坐标还可以降低对传感器特定辐射差异的敏感度，从而提高采集活动的鲁棒性。最后，我们使用描述站级地理、语义和时间条件的上下文辅助数据来增强几何信息。我们假设这些附加信息使模型能够捕获生态和物候的显着变化，而这些变化仅从点云几何形状中无法辨别。具体来说，我们进行编码（见图 1）。that focuses on above-ground biomass estimation. Second, we design the model to rely exclusively on the 3D spatial coordinates (XYZ) of each point, deliberately excluding intensity and echo-related attributes such as return number, number of returns, and scan angle. Although these features were initially considered, hyperparameter optimization revealed no consistent performance gains from their inclusion, while intensity measurements were discarded due to the lack of radiometric sensor calibration. Restricting the input to XYZ coordinates also improves robustness across acquisition campaigns by reducing sensitivity to sensor-specific radiometric differences. Finally, we augment geometric information with contextual auxiliary data describing stand-level geographical, semantic, and temporal conditions. We hypothesize that this additional information enables the model to capture ecological and phenological significant variability that is not discernible from point cloud geometry alone. Specifically, we encode (see Fig.3):

  • 1.

    地理语义变量（分类，20）：使用可学习嵌入层的树冠覆盖类别、成分类型和林区生态区域。Geographical-semantic variables (categorical, 20): canopy cover class, composition type, and sylvo-ecoregion using learnable embedding layers.

  • 2.

    地理知识（离散，4）：我们通过绘图中心位置的低维编码进一步包含空间上下文。Geographical knowledge (discrete, 4): we further include spatial context through a low-dimensional encoding of the plot center location.

  • 3.

    时间知识（离散，3）：LiDAR 采集日期用循环正弦表示（一年中某天的正弦和余弦）进行编码，而 LiDAR 采集和现场库存日期之间的时间间隙作为归一化标量。Temporal knowledge (discrete, 3): LiDAR acquisition date is encoded with a cyclic sinusoidal representation (sine and cosine of the day of year), while the temporal gap between the LiDAR acquisition and the field inventory date as a normalized scalar.

土地覆盖和森林形成类型是从 BD Forêt® v2 数据库获得的。 BD Forêt® v2 是一个描述法国森林组成的矢量数据库，并聚合为 32 个主要的纯森林和混合森林地层。与基于现场的测量不同（Land cover and type of forest formation are obtained from the BD Forêt®  v2 database. BD Forêt®  v2 is a vector database describing forest composition over France, and agregated into 32 main forest formations of pure and mixed compositions. Unlike field-based measurements (例如，e.g.,NFI 图）精度高但空间稀疏，BD Forêt® 提供适合大规模建模的全面覆盖。该数据库包括一个层次分类，根据树冠覆盖情况区分封闭和开放的森林，以及杨树种植园、荒地和草本地层。林分组成类别进一步区分纯阔叶林、纯针叶林和混交林。NFI plots), which are highly accurate but spatially sparse, BD Forêt®  offers wall-to-wall coverage suitable for large-scale modeling. The database includes a hierarchical classification that distinguishes closed and open forests according to canopy cover, as well as poplar plantations, heathlands, and herbaceous formations. Stand composition classes further differentiate pure broadleaf, pure conifer, and mixed forests.

所有辅助数据特征都连接成一个联合向量，并通过专用的多层感知器（MLP），以在共享潜在空间中生成学习的辅助数据表示。而不是像 FiLM 方法那样通过特征仿射变换来调制几何特征All auxiliary data features are concatenated into a joint vector and passed through a dedicated multi-layer perceptron (MLP) to produce a learned auxiliary data representation in a shared latent space. Rather than modulating geometric features through feature-wise affine transformations like the FiLM method(Perez et al., 2018)（在我们的例子中不成功），我们采用后期融合策略：辅助数据表示与 HRNet 主干提取的特征连接起来，并通过后续层联合处理（图 1）。(unsuccessful in our case), we adopt a late fusion strategy: the auxiliary data representation is concatenated with the features extracted by the HRNet backbone and jointly processed through subsequent layers (Fig.3E 部分）。为了使模型能够自适应地控制上下文信息的贡献，我们引入了一种门控机制，该机制可以为每个预测目标学习如何在几何驱动特征和融合表示之间进行插值（图 1）。part E). To allow the model to adaptively control the contribution of contextual information, we introduce a gating mechanism that learns, for each prediction target, how to interpolate between geometry-driven features and fused representations (Fig.3F 部分）。part F).

当使用完整的辅助数据集时，所得的 27 维表示将连接成单个特征向量。我们采用后期融合策略，将这种辅助表示与 HRNet 主干提取的几何 LiDAR 特征相结合。为了允许模型根据目标变量自适应地调节上下文信息的贡献，我们引入了When the full set of auxiliary data is used, the resulting 27-dimensional representation is concatenated into a single feature vector. We adopt a late-fusion strategy, in which this auxiliary representation is combined with the geometric LiDAR features extracted by the HRNet backbone. To allow the model to adaptively modulate the contribution of contextual information depending on the target variable, we introduce a特定目标的门控机制target-specific gating mechanism:

We hypothesize this design enables the network to selectively leverage auxiliary data when informative, while preserving robustness when such information noisy or less relevant.

超参数优化Hyperparameter optimization

深度学习模型的性能对超参数的选择高度敏感，例如学习率、批量大小和正则化系数。因此，超参数调整被表述为一个优化问题，其中选择超参数以最小化验证损失。常见的方法包括网格搜索、随机搜索和贝叶斯优化DL model performance is highly sensitive to the choice of hyperparameters, such as the learning rate, batch size, and regularization coefficients. Hyperparameter tuning is therefore formulated as an optimization problem in which hyperparameters are selected to minimize a validation loss. Common approaches include grid search, random search, and Bayesian optimization(Raiaan et al., 2024)。虽然网格搜索评估超参数的预定义组合，但从预定义分布中随机搜索样本，并且在高维空间中通常更有效. While grid search evaluates predefined combinations of hyperparameters, random search samples from predefined distributions and is generally more efficient in high-dimensional spaces(Bergstra et al., 2011)。贝叶斯优化通过使用代理概率模型对超参数和模型性能之间的关系进行建模，进一步提高了效率。 使用 Optuna 执行超参数优化. Bayesian optimization further improves efficiency by modeling the relationship between hyperparameters and model performance using surrogate probabilistic models. Hyperparameter optimization was performed using Optuna(Akiba et al., 2019)，一个开源框架，支持在执行期间动态构建搜索空间。 Optuna 依赖于基于树结构 Parzen 估计器的贝叶斯优化，该估计器自适应地对超参数空间的有希望的区域进行采样。此外，Optuna 集成了剪枝机制，可以提前停止无希望的试验，使其特别适合计算成本高昂的深度学习模型, an open-source framework that supports dynamic construction of the search space during execution. Optuna relies on Bayesian optimization based on a Tree-structured Parzen Estimator, which adaptively samples promising regions of the hyperparameter space. In addition, Optuna integrates pruning mechanisms that enable early stopping of unpromising trials, making it particularly suitable for computationally expensive DL models(Raiaan et al., 2024; Karakutuk et al., 2025)。 优化的超参数包括学习率、批量大小、丢失概率和权重衰减系数。选择这些超参数是因为它们对优化动态（学习率、批量大小）和泛化（dropout、权重衰减）影响最大。搜索空间是使用学习率的对数均匀采样和其余参数的分类采样来定义的。. The optimized hyperparameters included the learning rate, batch size, dropout probability and weight decay coefficient. These hyperparameters were selected as they have the greatest influence on optimization dynamics (learning rate, batch size) and generalization (dropout, weight decay). The search space was defined using log-uniform sampling for the learning rate and categorical sampling for the remaining parameters.

优化过程分两个连续阶段实施。首先，进行了固定次数的试验。由于数据集大小，50 次试验需要 100 小时的计算。尽管对超参数空间进行更广泛的探索是可取的，但该过程的高计算成本导致我们将搜索限制为 50 次试验。每次试验都包括对模型进行固定数量的 10 轮训练（初步结果表明模型大约在第 7 轮收敛）。候选配置根据其平均验证损失进行排名。然后选择前三个配置进行第二个评估阶段。在此阶段，使用五重交叉验证方案和大量训练纪元对每种配置进行重新训练和验证（20）。 最终的超参数集是根据第二阶段观察到的最低平均验证损失来选择的。这种两阶段策略允许有效探索超参数空间，同时提供对模型泛化性能的稳健且无偏差的估计。The optimization procedure was implemented in two sequential phases. First, a fixed number of trials were executed. Due to the dataset size, 50 trials required 100 hours of computation. Although a more extensive exploration of the hyperparameter space would have been desirable, the high computational cost of this procedure led us to limit the search to 50 trials. Each trial consisted of training the model for a fixed number of epochs of 10 (preliminary results showed that models converge approximately at epoch 7). Candidate configurations were ranked according to their mean validation loss. The top three configurations were then selected for a second evaluation phase. In this phase, each configuration was retrained and validated using a five-fold cross-validation scheme and a larger number of training epochs (20). The final set of hyperparameters was chosen based on the lowest mean validation loss observed during this second phase. This two-stage strategy allows efficient exploration of the hyperparameter space while providing a robust and unbiased estimate of model generalization performance.

2.2.2 研究设计Study Design

第节中概述的研究问题The research questions outlined in Section1通过四个互补的实验来解决，每个实验都隔离一个特定因素：物候条件对模型泛化的影响、类不平衡引入的潜在混淆、重叠多季节采集的作用以及辅助上下文变量的贡献及其整合的可解释性。are addressed through four complementary experiments, each isolating a specific factor: the effect of phenological conditions on model generalization, the potential confound introduced by class imbalance, the role of overlapping multi-season acquisitions, and the contribution of auxiliary contextual variables together with the interpretability of their integration.

下面介绍的所有模型均基于我们的All models introduced below were built upon our弗洛拉FLORA架构（参见章节architecture (see Section2.2.1）。他们使用配对 LiDAR 点云样本和 NFI 地面实况测量在监督框架中接受了 20 个具有优化超参数的训练。森林类型是根据 NFI 记录在地块级别定义的，区分落叶林、针叶林和). They were trained in a supervised framework using paired LiDAR point cloud samples and NFI ground truth measurement, for 20 epochs with optimized hyperparameters. Forest type was defined at the plot level from NFI records, distinguishing deciduous, coniferous, and混合的mixed站。物候类别是使用应用于采集日期的固定时间边界来定义的（叶开始：3月15日；叶开始：5月15日；叶关闭：9月15日；叶脱落：11月15日）：叶开始对应于冠层完全闭合，叶脱落对应于无叶冬季。过渡阶段被排除在外，以确保明确的阶级成员身份。 leaf-on 和 leaf-off 采集分别占总数据集的 54% 和 22%。stands. Phenological classes were defined using fixed temporal boundaries applied to acquisition dates (leaf-start: Mar. 15 ; leaf-on: May 15 ; leaf-shut: Sep. 15 ; leaf-off: Nov. 15): leaf-on corresponds to full canopy closure, and leaf-off to the leafless winter period. Transitional stages were excluded to ensure unambiguous class membership. leaf-on and leaf-off acquisitions represent 54% and 22% of the total dataset, respectively.

实验 1：全季节预测与特定季节预测Experiment 1: All-seasons versus season-specific prediction

我们评估在两个物候季节训练的单一模型是否可以概括以及特定季节的模型。训练了三个独立模型：We assess whether a single model trained on both phenological seasons generalizes as well as season-specific models. Three independent models were trained: a叶上模型leaf-on model (n=14,142n=14{,}142），一个), a离叶模型leaf-off model (n=5,675n=5{,}675），和一个), and a完整模型full model结合两个季节（combining both seasons (n=19,817n=19{,}817）。每个季节特定模型在两种条件下进行评估：). Each season-specific model was evaluated under two conditions:同赛季测试same-season testing（测试集与训练季节相匹配），并且(the test set matched the training season), and跨季节测试cross-season testing（该模型适用于相反季节的收购）。完整模型在两个季节都进行了评估。为了进一步区分类别分布与季节性覆盖的影响，完整的模型在平衡数据集上进行了额外的训练，通过对多数类别的欠采样强制执行相等的叶上和叶下表示；的(the model was applied to acquisitions from the opposite season). The full model was evaluated on both seasons. To further disentangle the effect of class distribution from that of seasonal coverage, the full model was additionally trained on a balanced dataset enforcing equal leaf-on and leaf-off representation through undersampling of the majority class; the平衡模型balanced model与不平衡的原始完整模型进行比较，以将类不平衡的贡献（54% 叶上 vs. 22% 叶落）与物候多样性的贡献分开。对于所有配置，样本分为 70% 训练、10% 验证和 20% 测试，并按物候类别和森林类型分层。and unbalanced original full model are compared to isolate the contribution of class imbalance (54% leaf-on vs. 22% leaf-off) from that of phenological diversity. For all configurations, samples were split into 70% training, 10% validation, and 20% test, stratified by phenological class and forest type.

实验 2：从重叠收购中获益Experiment 2: Benefiting from overlapping acquisitions

我们量化了在叶上和叶下条件下调查的地块的影响作为训练策略。比较了两个相同大小的数据集：一个完全由重叠的图对组成（We quantify the impact of plots surveyed under both leaf-on and leaf-off conditions as a training strategy. Two datasets of equal size were compared: one composed exclusively of overlapping plot pairs (即i.e.,两个季节都有收购的地块），还有一个仅限于单收购地块。重叠图有两个来源：相邻采集块之间的空间重叠，以及单个块内的飞行线侧重叠（当点云包含来自多个航班的数据时，使用 GPS 时间戳将点分开）。其中plots with acquisitions in both seasons), and one restricted to single-acquisition plots. Overlapping plots arise from two sources: spatial overlap between adjacent acquisition blocks, and flight-line sidelap within a single block (when point clouds contained data from multiple flights, points were separated using GPS timestamps). Among the1,2391{,}239仅在整个数据集中多次获取 NFI 图NFI plots acquired more than once across the full dataset, only3838在两个物候季节均观察到，产量were observed in both phenological seasons, yielding7676配对收购（paired acquisitions (3838叶上和leaf-on and3838落叶）。单次采集数据集构建为leaf-off). The single-acquisition dataset was constructed asK=3K=3大小相等的不相交子样本，从非重叠图池中不放回地抽取，确保没有图出现在多个子样本中。这两种条件均在仅由单次采集图组成的固定保留测试集上进行评估。绩效报告为平均值disjoint subsamples of equal size, drawn without replacement from the pool of non-overlapping plots, ensuring no plot appeared in more than one subsample. Both conditions were evaluated on a fixed holdout test set composed exclusively of single-acquisition plots. 实验3：评估辅助上下文信息的贡献Experiment 3: Assessing the contribution of auxiliary contextual information

为了评估辅助数据的贡献，在其他相同的条件下比较了两个模型：我们的To assess the contribution of auxiliary data, two models were compared under otherwise identical conditions: our完整模型full model结合生态和时空数据，通过后期融合门控机制融合（incorporating ecological and spatiotemporal data, fused via the late-fusion gating mechanism (辅助Aux），和一个), and a基础模型base model组成consisting of弗洛拉FLORA修改为仅依赖 LiDAR 点云功能（modified to rely solely on LiDAR point cloud features (无辅助No Aux）。门控系数). The gating coefficientgk∈[0,1]g_{k}\in[0,1]为每个目标变量学习learned for each target variablekk量化上下文信息对最终预测的相对贡献：接近 0 的值表示模型主要依赖于 LiDAR 导出的几何特征，而接近 1 的值表示辅助数据的主要贡献。由于门初始化于quantifies the relative contribution of contextual information to the final prediction: values close to 0 indicate the model relies primarily on LiDAR-derived geometric features, while values close to 1 indicate a dominant contribution from auxiliary data. Since the gates are initialized at0.50.5，保持接近该中点的值表明辅助信息既没有显着地产生积极作用也没有产生消极作用。因此，分析测试集上门值的分布提供了一种部分可解释性的形式，使我们能够根据森林属性来描述模型利用上下文信息的程度。这是通过消融协议来补充的，其中连续选择各个辅助变量来量化其边际贡献。两种模型变体均使用 Optuna（50 次试验）独立优化，并根据最低平均验证损失通过五倍交叉验证选择最佳超参数配置。, values remaining close to this midpoint suggest that the auxiliary information neither contributed positively nor negatively in a substantial way. Analyzing the distribution of gate values on the test set thus provides a form of partial interpretability, enabling us to characterize, per forest attribute, how much the model draws on contextual information. This is complemented by an ablation protocol in which individual auxiliary variables are successively selected to quantify their marginal contribution. Both model variants were optimized independently using Optuna (50 trials), with the best hyperparameter configuration selected by five-fold cross-validation based on the lowest mean validation loss.

3 结果Results

3.1 超参数调整Hyperparameter tuning

超参数优化表明，集成辅助数据从根本上重塑了优化格局，与基本模型相比，需要的学习率小 3.5 倍，批量大小减半，丢失率增加一倍，同时通过积极正则化的弹性展示更大的表征丰富性。Hyperparameter optimization revealed that integrating auxiliary data fundamentally reshapes the optimization landscape, requiring a learning rate 3.5 times smaller, half the batch size, and double the dropout rate compared to the base model, while simultaneously demonstrating greater representational richness through resilience to aggressive regularization.

这部分显示了使用上述设置对基本模型和完整模型独立进行的超参数优化的结果。值得注意的是，这两个变体收敛到明显不同的配置，这反映了辅助数据对模型学习动态的影响。学习率收敛到大约一个值This part shows the results of the hyperparameter optimization using the aforementioned setup, conducted independently for the base model and the full model. Notably, the two variants converged to markedly different configurations, which reflects the impact of auxiliary data on the model’s learning dynamics. The learning rate converged to a value approximately降低3.5倍3.5 times lower在辅助模型中（in the auxiliary model (4.457×10−44.457\times 10^{-4}与vs.1.570×10−31.570\times 10^{-3}），反映了异构信息源融合引起的更复杂的损失情况：门控机制必须学会平衡两个互补的流，因此对大梯度步长更加敏感。最佳批量大小同样), reflecting the more complex loss landscape induced by the fusion of heterogeneous information sources: the gating mechanism must learn to balance two complementary streams and is consequently more sensitive to large gradient steps. The optimal batch size likewise减半halved（16 vs. 32）：较小的批次会产生噪声较大的梯度估计，这些估计往往会收敛到更平坦、更通用的最小值(16 vs. 32): smaller batches produce noisier gradient estimates that tend to converge towards flatter, more generalizable minima(Keskar et al., 2017)。这在这里特别有用，因为辅助元数据引入了输入配置的组合多样性（. This is particularly beneficial here as the auxiliary metadata introduces a combinatorial diversity of input configurations (例如，e.g.,罕见的森林生态区和采集期组合），鼓励模型找到能够在这个扩展的输入空间中泛化的解决方案，而不是过度拟合最常见的协变量模式。最显着的差异是辍学率，rare sylvo-ecoregion and acquisition period combinations), encouraging the model to find solutions that generalize across this expanded input space rather than overfitting to the most frequent covariate patterns. The most striking difference concerns the dropout rate, which加倍doubled当引入辅助数据时（0.6 vs. 0.3）：与其仅仅将其视为一种防御性正则化措施，该结果可以被解读为辅助数据带来的表征丰富性的证据：尽管屏蔽激活的比例大幅提高，但模型仍然具有执行能力，这表明辅助特征为网络提供了足够的冗余和互补信号来容忍激进的信息丢失，同时通过处理高级上下文特征（例如森林类型、地理区域或采集）来防止模型短路点云处理日期，作为目标变量的直接代理。相反，重量衰减是when auxiliary data was introduced (0.6 vs. 0.3): rather than viewing this solely as a defensive regularization measure, this result can be read as evidence of the representational richness brought by auxiliary data: the model remains performative despite a substantially higher fraction of masked activations, suggesting that the auxiliary features provide sufficiently redundant and complementary signals for the network to tolerate aggressive information dropout, while simultaneously preventing the model from short-circuiting point cloud processing by treating high-level contextual features, such as forest type, geographic region, or acquisition date, as direct proxies for the target variable. Conversely, weight decay was减少约三倍reduced by a factor of approximately three (3.6×10−53.6\times 10^{-5}与vs.1×10−41\times 10^{-4}）：由于较强的 dropout 已经提供了实质性的正则化，因此较低的 dropout): since the stronger dropout already provides substantial regularization, a lowerℓ2\ell_{2}惩罚避免过度限制与分类元数据相关的可学习嵌入，这需要足够的参数自由度来编码类别之间有意义的区别。总而言之，这些结果描绘了辅助数据如何重塑优化问题的连贯图景：它极大地丰富了表示空间，正如模型对激进 dropout 的恢复能力所证明的那样，而多模态融合增加的复杂性需要更保守的梯度更新，而较小批次和减少的权重衰减的结合确保了这种更丰富的表示能够有效地泛化到输入配置的全部多样性中。penalty avoids over-constraining the learnable embeddings associated with categorical metadata, which require sufficient parametric freedom to encode meaningful distinctions between categories. Taken together, these results paint a coherent picture of how auxiliary data reshapes the optimization problem: it substantially enriches the representational space, as evidenced by the model’s resilience to aggressive dropout, while the added complexity of multimodal fusion calls for more conservative gradient updates, and the combination of smaller batches and reduced weight decay ensures that this richer representation generalizes effectively across the full diversity of input configurations.

3.2.3 特定季节型号Season-Specific Models

3.3 我们可以从重叠收购中受益吗？Can we benefit from overlapping acquisitions ?

LiDAR 采集之间的空间重叠会根据目标属性产生对比效果：总体积和落叶体积的体积估计显着改善，而针叶树体积、基底面积和密度下降，而高度基本上不受影响。Spatial overlap between LiDAR acquisitions produces contrasting effects depending on the target attribute: volumetric estimation improves substantially for total and deciduous volume, while coniferous volume, basal area, and density degrade, and height remains largely unaffected.

4.2 平衡训练的效果Effect of balanced training

平衡训练集以均衡叶上和叶外采集的表示会导致性能的适度和选择性下降。在叶上测试数据上，大多数属性在平衡配置下显示出稍高的误差，最显着的是针叶体积（+6 点 rRMSE）和茎密度（+3 点），而叶脱落性能在很大程度上保留或略有改善（表Balancing the training set to equalize the representation of leaf-on and leaf-off acquisitions leads to a moderate and selective degradation of performance. On leaf-on test data, most attributes show slightly higher errors under the balanced configuration, most notably for coniferous volume (+6 points rRMSE) and stem density (+3 points), while leaf-off performance is largely preserved or marginally improved (Table in6）。高度和底面积对平衡的敏感性最小，两个测试集上的差异均低于 1 分（图). Height and basal area show the smallest sensitivity to balancing, with differences below 1 point on both test sets (Figure4）。这种模式与原始数据集的组成一致：叶上采集代表了大部分地块，因此平衡有效地对主导季节进行了下采样，并减少了模型对最常发生的采集环境的暴露。有限的总体影响表明，原始的不平衡不会对整个模型产生严重偏差，并且鉴于其更好地利用可用训练数据，不平衡配置更适合操作使用。这与更广泛的类别不平衡学习的发现是一致的，其中对多数类别进行下采样往往会提高少数类别的表现，但会牺牲整体准确性). This pattern is consistent with the composition of the original dataset: leaf-on acquisitions represent the majority of plots, so balancing effectively down-samples the dominant season and reduces the model’s exposure to the most frequently occurring acquisition context. The limited overall impact suggests that the original imbalance does not critically bias the full model, and that the unbalanced configuration is preferable for operational use given its better exploitation of available training data. This is consistent with findings in class-imbalanced learning more broadly, where down-sampling the majority class tends to improve minority-class performance but at the cost of overall accuracy(Japkowicz and Stephen, 2002)

4.3 物候稳健性和季节特异性概括Phenological robustness and season-specific generalization

结果如表所示The results presented in Tables3和andC解决两个互补的问题：特定季节模型在其自己的采集季节是否优于完整模型，以及它们是否充分推广到相反的季节。address two complementary questions: whether season-specific models outperform the full model on their own acquisition season, and whether they generalize adequately to the opposite season.

4.3.1 同季表现及落叶优势Same-season performance and the advantage of leaf-off

在同季评估中，对于大多数体积属性，离叶模型的 rRMSE 低于留叶模型（In same-season evaluation, the leaf-off model achieves lower rRMSE than the leaf-on model for most volumetric attributes (例如，e.g.,总体积：39.67% vs. 41.80%），与文献一致，表明由于更大的冠层穿透力和改进的地面采样，落叶采集通常会产生更准确的体积估计total volume: 39.67% vs. 41.80%), consistent with the literature showing that leaf-off acquisitions generally yield more accurate volume estimates due to greater canopy penetration and improved ground sampling(Villikka et al., 2012; White et al., 2015)。然而，这种优势与属性相关：在落叶同季条件下，高度估计会大幅下降（落叶模型为 16.08%，而落叶模型为 13.98%），可能是因为树叶的缺失降低了冠层层之间的对比度，并降低了驱动高度预测的上部返回密度。这与研究结果一致. This advantage is however attribute-dependent: height estimation degrades substantially under leaf-off same-season conditions (16.08% vs. 13.98% for the leaf-on model), likely because the absence of foliage reduces the contrast between canopy strata and lowers the upper return density that drives height predictions. This is consistent with findings byDavison et al. (2020)，他们表明，落叶条件将回报分布转向较低的树冠水平，特别是在落叶林中。, who show that leaf-off conditions shift the return distribution toward lower canopy levels, particularly in deciduous stands.

落叶模型在同季节评估中也显示出落叶量明显下降，在没有辅助数据的情况下，rRMSE 从 118.77% 下降到超过 150% 的值。这反映了一个众所周知的困难：在落叶条件下，包含落叶树种和常绿树种的混合林分呈现出不明确的返回分布，因为保留的针叶树叶子引入了结构噪声，使物种特定贡献的分离变得复杂The leaf-off model also shows marked degradation for deciduous volume in same-season evaluation, with rRMSE dropping from 118.77% to values exceeding 150% without auxiliary data. This reflects a well-known difficulty: under leaf-off conditions, mixed stands containing both deciduous and evergreen species present ambiguous return distributions, as retained conifer foliage introduces structural noise that complicates the separation of species-specific contributions(Villikka et al., 2012). White et al. (2015)报告了类似的模式，并指出落叶模型对于落叶量属性显示出更大的误差，特别是对于可销售的量，其中 rRMSE 在叶子条件之间可能相差高达 7%。report similar patterns, noting that leaf-off models show larger errors for deciduous volume attributes, particularly for merchantable volume, where rRMSE can differ by up to 7% between leaf conditions.

4.3.2 跨季节泛化和不对称可转移性Cross-season generalization and asymmetric transferability

跨季节的概括是强烈不对称的。应用于叶离采集的叶上模型在大多数属性上保持了可接受的性能：总体积达到 39.43% rRMSE (RCross-season generalization is strongly asymmetric. The leaf-on model applied to leaf-off acquisitions maintains acceptable performance for most attributes: total volume reaches 39.43% rRMSE (R2= 0.60），接近其同赛季表现，身高仍保持在 12.22% 的强劲水平（R= 0.60), close to its same-season performance, and height remains robust at 12.22% (R2= 0.78）。相比之下，应用于叶上采集的叶离模型严重退化：总体积增加至 65.15%（R= 0.78). By contrast, the leaf-off model applied to leaf-on acquisitions degrades severely: total volume increases to 65.15% (R2= 0.38)，针叶树体积降至 85.96%，落叶树体积锐减至 196.29% (R= 0.38), coniferous volume to 85.96%, and deciduous volume collapses to 196.29% (R2 = −-0.19）。这种不对称性符合0.19). This asymmetry is consistent withWhite et al. (2015)，他们报告说，将离叶模型应用于八个森林属性（顶部高度、平均高度、Lorey 平均高度、断面积、二次平均直径、可销售体积、总体积和地上总生物量）的叶上数据，导致针叶林的平均绝对 rRMSE 增加 16.8%，落叶林的平均绝对 rRMSE 增加 25.8%，并且, who report that applying leaf-off models to leaf-on data on eight forest attributes (top height, mean height, Lorey’s mean height, basal area, quadratic mean diameter, merchantable volume, total volume, and total aboveground biomass) results in average absolute rRMSE increases of 16.8% for coniferous stands and 25.8% for deciduous stands, and withVillikka et al. (2012)，他们观察到，应用于叶上落叶地块的叶离模型产生的 rRMSE 超过 70%，偏差接近 50%。物理解释很简单：在叶子点云上训练的模型，其中回报集中在较低的树冠和地面上，缺乏解释更密集和更高的回报分布的代表性能力，代表叶子上的采集, who observe that a leaf-off model applied to leaf-on deciduous plots yields rRMSE exceeding 70% and bias approaching 50%. The physical explanation is straightforward: a model trained on leaf-off point clouds, where returns are concentrated in the lower canopy and on the ground, lacks the representational capacity to interpret the denser and higher return distributions, representative of leaf-on acquisitions(Ørka et al., 2010).

4.3.3 对采购计划的实际影响Practical implications for acquisition planning

这些结果对森林清查提出了一个实际问题：什么时候最好获取叶上数据和叶下数据？答案取决于预期的应用。地形建模和考古勘探通常首选落叶采集，其中减少的树叶可以改善地面返回检测和森林冠层下微地形特征的可见性These results raise a practical question for operational forest inventory: when is it preferable to acquire leaf-on versus leaf-off data? The answer depends on the intended application. Leaf-off acquisitions are generally preferred for terrain modeling and archaeological prospection, where reduced foliage improves ground return detection and the visibility of micro-topographic features beneath forest canopies(Simpson et al., 2017; Moudrý et al., 2019)。相反，叶上采集提供了冠层燃料和植被连续性的更真实的表征，使它们更适合与野火相关的测绘应用. Conversely, leaf-on acquisitions provide a more realistic characterization of canopy fuels and vegetation continuity, making them more suitable for wildfire-related mapping applications(Moran et al., 2020)。 对于多属性森林清查，我们的结果表明，当需要跨季节概括时，考虑到叶上采集对于落叶条件的优越可转移性，它们是更可取的。然而，采集季节并不总是一个自由参数：由于积雪阻碍了落叶调查，山区通常只能在落叶条件下才能进入。监管限制可能会进一步限制某些地区的收购窗口。这些操作现实激励了能够处理异构采集条件的模型的开发，这正是全面的挑战. For multi-attribute forest inventory, our results suggest that leaf-on acquisitions are preferable when cross-season generalization is required, given their superior transferability to leaf-off conditions. However, acquisition season is not always a free parameter: mountainous areas are often only accessible under leaf-on conditions due to snow cover precluding leaf-off surveys. Regulatory constraints can further restrict the acquisition window in some regions. These operational realities motivate the development of models capable of handling heterogeneous acquisition conditions, precisely the challenge that the full弗洛拉FLORA型号地址。model addresses.

4.3.4 完整的模型作为强大的运营解决方案The full model as a robust operational solution

无论测试集物候如何，完整的模型都经过叶上和叶下数据的训练，始终优于特定季节的模型。在同季评估中，其优势在落叶时最为明显，将总体积 rRMSE 从 39.67% 降低至 36.21%，并将高度误差差距几乎减半（11.44% vs. 16.08%，RThe full model, trained on both leaf-on and leaf-off data, consistently outperforms season-specific models regardless of the test set phenology. In same-season evaluation, its advantage is clearest on leaf-off, where it reduces total volume rRMSE from 39.67% to 36.21% and nearly halves the height error gap (11.44% vs. 16.08%, R2= 0.81 与 0.63)。在跨季节设置中，它避免了离叶特定模型的严重退化，使开叶时体积rRMSE保持在40.83%，而离叶模型达到65.15%。这与= 0.81 vs. 0.63). In cross-season setting, it avoids the severe degradation of the leaf-off-specific model, maintaining volume rRMSE at 40.83% on leaf-on ,where the leaf-off model reaches 65.15%. This is consistent withWhite et al. (2015)，他们表明，在两个季节训练的汇集模型在同季节评估中达到了叶上模型和叶离模型之间的中间性能，同时大大优于跨季节模型混合。我们的结果将这一发现扩展到全国范围内的深度学习环境，表明对异质物候条件进行训练不仅可行，而且比任何特定季节的策略都能产生更可靠的预测，考虑到法国国家 LiDAR 计划中叶上/叶下覆盖的不均匀和分散性，这一结果实际上非常重要。, who show that pooled models trained on both seasons achieve intermediate performance between leaf-on and leaf-off models in same-season evaluation, while substantially outperforming cross-season model-mixing. Our results extend this finding to a DL setting at the national scale, suggesting that training on heterogeneous phenological conditions is not only feasible but produces more robust predictions than any season-specific strategy, a practically important result given the uneven and fragmented nature of leaf-on/leaf-off coverage across the French national LiDAR programme.

4.4 重叠收购的贡献Contribution of overlapping acquisitions

重叠图Overlapping plots即i.e.,在叶子打开和叶子关闭条件下进行调查，通过将模型锚定到对比背景下同一森林的配对观察来提供独特的训练信号。结果见表surveyed under both leaf-on and leaf-off conditions, provide a unique training signal by anchoring the model to paired observations of the same forest under contrasting contexts. The results in Table9和图and Figure5表明利用这些重叠会产生对比效果，具体取决于目标属性。 总乳量和乳牙量的性能改善最为明显，rRMSE 分别降低约 5 点和 12 点。这表明配对物候观测有助于模型更好地理清跨季节阔叶结构信号。在重叠条件下，高度也显示出适度但一致的改进。这些成果与共同注册的多季节收购提供互补的树冠渗透剖面的前提是一致的，这些剖面为阔叶体积估计提供了信息show that exploiting these overlaps yields contrasting effects, depending on the target attribute. Performance improves most clearly for total and deciduous volume, with rRMSE reductions of approximately 5 and 12 points respectively. This suggests that paired phenological observations help the model better disentangle broadleaf structural signals across seasons. Height also shows modest but consistent improvements under the overlap condition. These gains are coherent with the premise that co-registered multi-seasonal acquisitions provide complementary canopy penetration profiles that are informative for broadleaf volume estimation(Ørka et al., 2010; Davison et al., 2020).

针叶树体积呈现相反的趋势，rRMSE从73.15%增加到80.87%，RConiferous volume shows the opposite trend, with rRMSE increasing from 73.15% to 80.87% and R2重叠条件下从 0.441 下降到 0.324。断面积和茎密度也略有下降。这个结果是违反直觉的，但可能反映了重叠子集的有限大小和地理范围：重叠区域代表了地理上受限制的领土部分，并且在这些地块上训练的模型可能缺乏针叶林类型的足够多样性来进行概括。此外，针叶林在物候条件下结构比落叶林更稳定dropping from 0.441 to 0.324 under the overlap condition. Basal area and stem density also degrade slightly. This result is counterintuitive but may reflect the limited size and geographic scope of the overlap subset: overlapping areas represent a geographically constrained fraction of the territory, and the model trained on these plots may lack sufficient diversity in coniferous stand types to generalize. Furthermore, coniferous stands are structurally more stable across phenological conditions than deciduous stands(Wasser et al., 2013)，这意味着成对的叶上/叶下观测为针叶树提供的互补结构信息相对较少。因此，将训练限制在重叠图上可能会降低有效样本多样性，而无法提供配对物候对比的补偿优势，从而推动阔叶体积估计的改进。这表明利用密集的光学时间序列（, meaning that paired leaf-on/leaf-off observations provide comparatively less complementary structural information for conifers. As a result, restricting training to overlap plots likely reduces effective sample diversity, without providing the compensating benefit of paired phenological contrast that drives improvements for broadleaf volume estimation. This suggests that exploiting dense optical time series (例如，e.g.,Landsat 或 Sentinel-2）可以通过捕获单一日期或采集相关观测无法解决的物候变化来帮助减轻这些限制。时间序列方法通过将物候驱动的光谱信号与结构变异分开来改善森林类型的区分，这在季节对比较弱且信息量较少的混合或针叶林为主的林分中尤其相关Landsat or Sentinel-2) can help mitigate these limitations by capturing phenological variability that single-date or acquisition-tied observations cannot resolve. Time series approaches improve the discrimination of forest types by separating phenology-driven spectral signals from structural variability, which is particularly relevant in mixed or conifer-dominated stands where seasonal contrast is weaker and less informative(Guindon et al., 2024).

4.5 辅助变量的附加值Added value of auxiliary variables

上下文变量的相关性通过直接辅助（The relevance of contextual variables was evaluated both through direct Aux (弗洛拉FLORA)/无辅助比较 ()/No Aux comparisons (4和and8）并通过消融门控分析（图) and through ablation gating analysis (Figure7）。总之，这些结果表明，辅助元数据对整体和同季节条件的改善有限，但在跨季节概括方面取得了实质性进展，并且森林属性和森林类型地层之间存在强烈对比。). Together, these results reveal that auxiliary metadata provides limited improvements in overall and same‑season conditions, but substantial gains in cross‑season generalization, with strong contrasts across forest attributes and forest‑type strata.

在跨季节设置中，改进会更大。当在相反的季节进行测试时，这两个特定季节的模型都表现出强烈的误差膨胀，在这些情况下，辅助元数据起着主要的稳定作用。例如，在叶上测试的叶离模型显示，总体积的 rRMSE 从 97.7% 降低到 65.1%，针叶体积从 121.9% 降低到 85.9%，落叶体积从 367% 降低到 196%。在落叶交叉测试的落叶模型中观察到类似的效果，落叶量 rRMSE 从 168.8% 提高到 129.4%。这些结果证实，时间和生态元数据可以补偿季节性结构变化，尤其是在冠层几何信息较少的落叶采集中。The improvements become much larger in cross‑season settings. Both season‑specific models exhibit strong error inflation when tested on the opposite season, and in these cases auxiliary metadata plays a major stabilizing role. For example, the leaf-off model tested on leaf-on exhibits rRMSE reductions from 97.7% to 65.1% for total volume, from 121.9% to 85.9% for coniferous volume, and from 367% to 196% for deciduous volume. Similar effects are observed for the leaf-on model cross‑tested on leaf-off, with deciduous volume rRMSE improving from 168.8% to 129.4%. These results confirm that temporal and ecological metadata compensate for seasonal structural shifts—especially in leaf-off acquisitions where canopy geometry is less informative.

针叶树体积Coniferous volume和and乳牙量deciduous volume从辅助信息中获益最多，这与它们在点云中的低几何可辨别性一致。消融门识别benefit the most from auxiliary information, consistent with their low geometric discriminability in the point cloud. Ablation gates identify三角洲delta, 中心center和and塞内尔SER作为最有影响力的变量，Aux/No Aux 比较通过系统 rRMSE 和 R 证实了这一点as the most influential variables, and the Aux/No Aux comparisons confirm this through systematic rRMSE and R2纯针叶林和纯落叶林的增益。这与物种类型的强烈空间隔离是一致的（gains for pure coniferous and pure deciduous stands. This is coherent with the strong spatial segregation of species types (例如，e.g.,针叶树位于更高的海拔），上下文变量使这一点变得明确。相比之下，当添加辅助数据时，混合林通常会退化，这表明生态元数据推动模型过度解释粗略的物种模式，而这些模式不能反映混合林的更精细的结构镶嵌。coniferous stands at higher elevation), which the contextual variables make explicit. In contrast, mixed stands often degrade when auxiliary data is added, suggesting that ecological metadata pushes the model towards over‑interpreting coarse species patterns that do not reflect the finer structural mosaics of mixed forests.

总体积和断面积Total volume and basal area显示出适度的门激活和相应的适度但稳定的改进，特别是通过show moderate gate activations and correspondingly modest but stable improvements, particularly through the中心center和and塞尔ser变量。这两个变量捕捉了生产力和森林结构的区域趋势，而激光雷达无法完全编码。它们的效果在大多数模型和测试条件下仍然是积极的。variables. These two variables capture regional trends in productivity and forest structure that LiDAR alone cannot fully encode. Their effects remain positive across most models and test conditions.

身高Height是唯一基本上不受辅助元数据影响的属性。门激活是异构的，但不会转化为性能增益/所有表中的辅助/无辅助比较显示变化低于 0.2% rRMSE。这证实了高度几乎完全由激光雷达冠层几何形状决定，并且很大程度上独立于生态描述符。is the only attribute essentially unaffected by auxiliary metadata. Gate activations are heterogeneous but do not translate into performance gains/ The Aux/No Aux comparisons across all tables show changes below 0.2% rRMSE. This confirms that height is almost entirely determined by LiDAR canopy geometry and largely independent of ecological descriptors.

茎密度Stem density表现出更复杂的模式。在同季节测试中，辅助变量会轻微降低性能，这与快捷学习动态一致，其中分类元数据对粗密度先验进行编码，从而干扰结构上较弱的激光雷达信号。然而，在跨季节测试中，效果却相反：密度 rRMSE 大幅提高（exhibits a more complex pattern. In same‑season tests, auxiliary variables mildly degrade performance, consistent with shortcut learning dynamics where categorical metadata encodes coarse density priors that interfere with the structurally weak LiDAR signal. However, in cross‑season tests, the effect reverses: density rRMSE improves substantially (例如，e.g.,对于在叶上测试的叶离模型，82.1% → 67.8%）。因此，虽然元数据在同质采集环境中可能是有害的，但当采集条件发生变化时，它提供了有价值的稳定性，反映了针对特定物种体积观察到的行为。82.1% → 67.8% for the leaf-off model tested on leaf-on). Thus, while metadata can be detrimental in homogeneous acquisition contexts, it provides valuable stabilization when acquisition conditions shift, mirroring the behaviour observed for species‑specific volumes.

总体而言，Overall,中心center, 塞尔ser, 和, and三角洲delta脱颖而出，成为提供最可靠改进的变量——特别是对于与体积相关的属性和跨季节场景——同时stand out as the variables providing the most reliable improvements—particularly for volume‑related attributes and in cross‑season scenarios—while日期date和and封面cover贡献很少或不一致。直接性能比较和门控分析的融合强调，辅助变量并非普遍有益，但当仅 LiDAR 几何结构不足以捕获生态变化或弥合采集条件的强烈变化时，辅助变量就变得至关重要。contribute little or inconsistently. The convergence of direct performance comparisons and gating analysis highlights that auxiliary variables are not universally beneficial but become crucial whenever LiDAR geometry alone is insufficient to capture ecological variability or to bridge strong shifts in acquisition conditions.

5 结论Conclusion

本研究介绍了This study introduced弗洛拉FLORA是一个基于体素的深度学习框架，用于根据全国范围内的异构机载 LiDAR 数据预测六种森林结构属性，在法国大陆的 32,052 个 NFI 地块上进行了训练和评估。, a voxel-based DL framework for predicting six forest structural attributes from heterogeneous airborne LiDAR data at national scale, trained and evaluated on 32,052 NFI plots across mainland France.

主要发现如下。在叶上和叶下采集上联合训练的单一模型始终优于特定季节模型，包括在各自的校准域内，并且避免了将叶下模型应用于叶上数据时观察到的强烈跨季节退化。叶上样本和叶离样本之间的初始类别不平衡不会使整个模型产生偏差，并且使用所有可用的训练数据证明比强制类别平衡更可取。在这两种物候条件下获得的地块改善了阔叶林和总体积的估计，而它们对针叶林的益处是有限的。辅助上下文变量提供了适度但一致的增益，特别是对于特定物种的体积和跨季节的概括，而主导高度几乎完全由点云几何形状驱动。The main findings are as follows. A single model trained jointly on leaf-on and leaf-off acquisitions consistently outperforms season-specific models, including within their respective calibration domains, and avoids the strong cross-season degradation observed when leaf-off models are applied to leaf-on data. The initial class imbalance between leaf-on and leaf-off samples does not bias the full model, and using all available training data proves preferable to enforcing class balance. Plots acquired under both phenological conditions improve estimates of broadleaf and total volume, while their benefit for coniferous stands is limited. Auxiliary contextual variables provide modest but consistent gains, particularly for species-specific volumes and cross-season generalization, whereas dominant height is driven almost entirely by point cloud geometry.

总的来说，这些结果表明，在足够大和多样化的国家规模数据上训练的通用深度学习方法可以处理采集异质性，例如法国 LiDAR HD 的方法，而无需按季节、传感器或森林类型进行明确的分层。该模型还表现出很强的泛化性，这对于激光雷达采集空间异构的大规模应用来说越来越关键，需要能够在广泛区域内具有稳健性能的方法。特定物种的体积预测仍然是主要限制，这突出表明需要整合密集的光学时间序列，以更好地捕获物候变化并实现可操作的全面测绘。Overall, these results show that a generic DL approach trained on sufficiently large and diverse national-scale data can handle acquisition heterogeneity such as that of the French LiDAR HD without explicit stratification by season, sensor, or forest type. The model also exhibits strong generalization, an increasingly critical requirement for large-scale applications where LiDAR acquisitions are spatially heterogeneous, calling for methods capable of robust performance over extensive areas. Species-specific volume prediction remains the main limitation, highlighting the need to integrate dense optical time series to better capture phenological variation and enable operational wall-to-wall mapping.
